name: Borscht
time: ~1 hr 45 min, ~40 min hands-on (mostly simmering; estimated)

steps.title: Simmer the beef
steps.body: Simmer about 1½ hours: **1 pound lean beef**, cubed, **1½ quart water** and **1 Tbsp salt**.

steps.title: Simmer the vegetables
steps.body: In another pan, simmer covered, for about 15 minutes, stirring frequently: **1½ cups shredded raw beets**, **¾ cup shredded carrots**, **¾ cup shredded turnips**, **2 Tbsp tomato puree**, **2 Tbsp vinegar**, **1 tsp sugar**, **2 Tbsp butter** and **2 bay leaves**.

steps.title: Add the cabbage
steps.body: Add and cook about 10 minutes: **½ head small cabbage**, shredded.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.body: Mix, and season with vinegar, a (tiny bit of) sugar, and pepper as needed. Serve with sour cream.
